method: Complete independent Git snapshot of all existing tracked files plus proposed files, bundled with --all; also an incremental bundle of a temporary candidate commit against the original base commit.
limitations: The supplied repository lacks some historical Git objects, so bundling its entire ancestry fails. Both its current tracked tree and the exact pinned implementation ABIs are available. Complete tree snapshot and incremental submission sizes are measured instead.
Original workspace Git metadata is read-only. All commits and bundles here are temporary validation artifacts; the prepared workspace files still need the publisher commit.
